name: Godzilla Minus Collection
original_name: ゴジラ-（マイナス）シリーズ
overview: Film series by Takashi Yamazaki featuring Godzilla.

parts.title: Godzilla Minus One
parts.overview: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

parts.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
parts.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
